successCases.paperWorking: Ignore is 120 and Shout is 110. Both timers are zero, so 120 > 110 selects side 0.
Shout is 110 and Ignore is 120. A zero-timer bold character is not overridden; side 1 wins.
Sophistry is 20; matching Trend large is 1 + 2 + 10 = 13. Side 0 wins.
Matching Story small is 1 + 0 + 10 = 11 and medium is 1 + 1 + 10 = 12.
Story large is off-topic at 1 + 2 = 3; matching Logic small is 1 + 0 + 10 = 11.
Matching Logic medium is 1 + 1 + 10 = 12 and large is 1 + 2 + 10 = 13.
Matching Trend small is 11 and medium is 12.
Trend large is off-topic at 3; Story large matches for 13. Zero-timer bold retains 3.
Topic -1 is accepted but invalid for matching. Story small and medium retain level-only powers 1 and 2.
Topic 3 is accepted but outside 0..2. Trend medium and large retain powers 2 and 3.
The signed-32 minimum topic is accepted without a bonus. Two large off-topic cards each have power 3, so the attacker remains -1.
The signed-32 maximum topic is accepted without a bonus; small 1 loses to large 3.
Rethink and Compose take the default-zero power branch. Equal final powers leave attacker -1.
Agitate and the negative card code both have base power 0. A zero-timer bold side keeps 0.
Both signed-32 card extremes are accepted out-of-range queries with base power 0.
Card -2 and card 15 are outside the enum but inside signed-32; both use the default-zero branch.
Positive timers alone do not override powers. Timid Ignore stays 120 and calm Shout stays 110.
Reckless and calm with timer 4 are not bold. Sophistry remains 20 and matching Logic large remains 13.
Bold with timer 0 retains Ignore 120. Positive timid retains Shout 110; side 0 wins.
Bold timer 1 assigns 100 over Ignore base 120, lowering it. Normal Shout 110 then wins for side 1.
Bold timer 4 assigns 100 over Shout base 110, lowering it; 100 still beats Sophistry 20.
Normal Ignore remains 120. Bold matching Story large is overwritten from 13 to 100; normal Ignore wins.
Normal Shout remains 110. Bold Rethink is a zero-base query overwritten to 100, which still loses.
Positive bold overwrites Rethink base 0 with 100. Matching Trend large stays 13.
Both cards begin at 0. Positive bold overwrites even the signed-32 minimum unknown card with 100; positive reckless is unchanged.
Calm Sophistry stays 20. Side-1 bold overwrites the unknown maximum signed-32 card from 0 to 100 and wins.
Both independent bold overrides assign 100, lowering both initial fixed powers. Equal final powers retain -1.
Timers 2 and 3 are both positive. Compose and Agitate start at 0 and both become 100, so the result is a tie.
Both Shouts have 110. Positive reckless does not override and no personality tie-break is used.
Invalid topic 3 gives neither medium card a bonus. Both powers are 2, regardless of card topic or positive timid timer.
Zero-timer bold keeps Ignore 120 while positive bold Agitate becomes 100. Only the positive side is overridden.
Positive reckless and timid do not override. Matching Story small remains 11 and nonmatching Trend small remains 1.
